title: Ratsputin's Nesting Dolls: Fire Mutants
description: Ratsputin's Nesting Dolls: Fire Mutants — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Slay the Fire Mutant Nesting Dolls in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing B, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2 in Ratsputin's Gulag Level 5, then return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Slay the Fire Mutant Nesting Dolls in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing B, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2 in Ratsputin's Gulag Level 5, then return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

The Fire Mutant Nesting Dolls are as much of an enigma as the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls. Perhaps if you study the Fire Mutant Nesting Dolls you will be able to figure out their secret. I must know how they are able to store themselves in one another. If you are able to figure out how they do it I think I can use their secret to create something that I have been wanting to make and sell for ages: Magic Bag of Holding Hands. Let's say you are running the dungeon and you get a little lonely. Well, thanks to the Magic Bag of Holding Hands, you can just open up the bag, put your hand in, and you can hold hands with a magic hand giving you the security you've been missing since your mum decided to wean you onto health potions when you were a wee babe. I've tried to make it work before, but since I can only fit one hand in it, the magic hand gets all sweaty and clammy.

Will you seek out the Fire Mutant Nesting Dolls for me? I have heard of Dungeon Runners seeing them in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing B, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2 in Ratsputin's Gulag Level 5. Go there and slay the Fire Mutant Nesting dolls in the name of science! Return to me, Audrey the Alchemist, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

You found them? You slew them? You researched what was left? Wonderful work, Dungeon Runner!

Objectives:

  • Slay Fire Mutant Hulk Nesting Doll
  • Slay Fire Mutant Puker Nesting Doll
  • Slay Fire Mutant Twins Nesting Doll
  • Slay Fire Mutant Unipsycho Nesting Doll
  • Slay Fire Mutant Pincer Nesting Doll

Client level range: 85–100
